lines.zh: 我侧着身子，让鳍慢慢划。
lines.en: I tilt on my side and row with my fins.

lines.zh: 圆盘一样的身子，转不快。
lines.en: A body like a millstone does not turn quickly.

lines.zh: 我扇着背鳍，像扇一把旧扇。
lines.en: I fan my dorsal fin like an old fan.
Water slides past both my flanks.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，鱼群超了我。
lines.en: I swim slowly; schools of fish overtake me.

lines.zh: 尾巴几乎没有，我靠鳍走路。
lines.en: I have barely a tail; I walk on my fins.

lines.zh: 我把身子摆正，往光那边去。
lines.en: I right myself and head for the light.

lines.zh: 深一点的水，压得我发沉。
lines.en: Deeper water makes me heavy.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面走，影子在下面。
lines.en: I skim the surface; my shadow trails below.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在水里推门。
lines.en: Each stroke is like pushing a door underwater.
Turning takes me half the sea.
Jellyfish drift ahead; I follow them.
Two strokes, then a rest.

lines.zh: 海底的沙很软，蹭着舒服。
lines.en: The seafloor sand is soft against me.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，绕过一片水母。
lines.en: I tilt my body around a patch of jellyfish.
I drift slowly along the warm current.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，让太阳照肚皮。
lines.en: I roll over and let the sun warm my belly.
The surface lies flat as sheet metal.
I float with my fin tips above water.
A seabird is waiting for me to turn over.
I close my eyes; the light is still red.
The parasites on me are stirring.
This patch of water is warm.
I make one slow turn.
The sun bakes the laziness into me.
I float against a raft of kelp.

lines.zh: 浪把我推出去，又送回来。
lines.en: A swell pushes me out and brings me back.

lines.zh: 我听见鲸在很远的地方叫。
lines.en: I hear a whale call from very far away.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水母漂进来。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, waiting for jellyfish.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子是我自己。
lines.en: The shadow under the surface is my own.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼在我影子下躲着。
lines.en: A small fish hides under my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在水面画了一圈。
lines.en: My fin draws a circle on the surface.
You are on a boat, taller than me.
You lean over the gunwale to look at me.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，回了你一眼。
lines.en: I tilt over and look back at you.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着桶，我太大了。
lines.en: You hold a bucket; I am too big.

lines.zh: 你在水里，脚够不到底吧。
lines.en: You are in the water; your feet cannot reach bottom.

lines.zh: 我眼睛在两侧，看你两只手。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides; I see both your hands.

lines.zh: 你划水的声音传得很远。
lines.en: Your paddling carries far.
The water cools a notch as you near.
I turn slowly to face you squarely.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，鳍刚好够到。
lines.en: My fin just reaches where you stand.
My hide is thick, yet it still hurts.

lines.zh: 那一下穿过水，打在我身上。
lines.en: The blow crossed the water and found me.
I tilt and cannot hold level.

lines.zh: 血在水里散成一小片云。
lines.en: Blood spreads in a small cloud.
Two fin strokes and I steady myself.
The parasites have bitten me longer than this.
I let out a dull thump of sound.
Pain makes me swim faster than usual.
My shadow shrinks beneath me.
I am still here, only slower.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃桶，我听见水响。
lines.en: You shake the bucket; I hear the water.
The bucket is too small; I will not fit.

lines.zh: 那里面有水母的味道吗？
lines.en: Does it smell of jellyfish?
I nudge closer to the rim.
Lift it higher; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我不吃鱼，只吃软的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat fish; I eat soft things.
It glints and dazzles my eyes.

lines.zh: 你要是撒些碎食，我会来。
lines.en: Scatter some scraps and I will come.
I open my mouth and close it.

lines.zh: 桶底那点水，盖不住我的鳍。
lines.en: The water in that bucket will not cover my fin.
You hit me like a wall.

lines.zh: 我的皮上全是黏沫，抓不稳。
lines.en: My skin is covered in slime; you cannot grip it.
Do not push me from below.
My fin nearly swept you.

lines.zh: 你撞完弹回去，我晃都没晃。
lines.en: You struck and rebounded; I did not even sway.
I am heavy; a bump lands hard.
You stepped on my back.
I shift aside to give you room.

lines.zh: 蜡一样的皮，蹭了你一身。
lines.en: My waxy skin leaves a smear on you.

lines.zh: 下次绕开我，省得两人都累。
lines.en: Go around next time; it saves us both.
Another round shadow floats far off.
I row toward it, slowly.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，像两只盘子。
lines.en: We float side by side like two plates.

lines.zh: 海面被我们压出两道纹。
lines.en: We press two lines into the surface.
Its fin is a little wider than mine.
We circle each other, clumsily.
The eggs will drift off, unseen.
We touch fin tips.

lines.zh: 阳光照着两只晒肚皮的。
lines.en: The sun warms two bellies at once.

lines.zh: 明年这片海会有更多圆影子。
lines.en: Next year this sea will hold more round shadows.

lines.zh: 有东西飘过来，我顶了顶。
lines.en: Something drifts over; I nudge it.
A hard shard; I spat it out.
I touch the driftwood with my mouth.
Kelp tangles on my fin.
I push the floating thing away.

lines.zh: 有根绳子绕住了我的头。
lines.en: A rope loops around my head.
I bite it; it is not food.

lines.zh: 那小东西沉下去，我够不到。
lines.en: The small thing sinks beyond my reach.
I nose the bottle back toward shore.
Everything that drifts here is useless.
Something is following me underwater.
That shadow is not a jellyfish.
It is far faster than me.
I turn to face it head-on.
The water suddenly turns cold.
I see a row of teeth.
It keeps circling me.
I am too big to hide.
I raise my dorsal fin.
It closes in; the water parts.
I track it with eyes on either side.
Each circle it makes, I lag half a beat.
I turn my broad side to face it.

lines.zh: 我等着它先把牙露出来。
lines.en: I wait for its teeth to show first.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被它搅起来了。
lines.en: It stirs up the sandy floor.
My fins are braced.

lines.zh: 它想找我的侧面，我不给。
lines.en: It wants my flank; I deny it.
I back toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩一臂的水。
lines.en: Only an arm's width of water is left.
It charges straight at me.

lines.zh: 我甩动身子，撞了它一下。
lines.en: I swing my bulk and hit it once.
My fin edge grazes its gills.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我尽力了。
lines.en: The blow is light, but I gave it all.
My weight drives it down.
I bite and catch only water.

lines.zh: 皮太滑，它从我身上滑走。
lines.en: My hide is slick; it slides off me.

lines.zh: 我用整个圆盘把它推开。
lines.en: I shove it away with my whole disc.
It retreats; I do not chase.
The impact leaves me a little dazed.
Do not make a slow fish fight.
I rise out of the deep.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，我朝它去。
lines.en: Light leaks down; I go toward it.

lines.zh: 我第一次把背鳍露出海面。
lines.en: I lift my dorsal fin above the sea for the first time.
A bloom of jellyfish surrounds me.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有一枚硬币大。
lines.en: I was the size of a coin at birth.

lines.zh: 海水托着我，我不必用力。
lines.en: The sea holds me; I need not strain.

lines.zh: 我在海藻林的边缘停下。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of the kelp forest.
The sun is right; I spread myself out.
This sea is empty enough to turn in.
There is a boat far off; I keep away.
Fire on the surface; I sink below it.

lines.zh: 我摔在湿沙上，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I land on wet sand and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 我在空气里张着嘴，喘不上气。
lines.en: In the air I gape and cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 水被掀开，我的鳍全麻了。
lines.en: The water is torn open; my fins go numb.
An arrow lodges at the base of my fin.

lines.zh: 有个声音在我头里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: A voice buzzes inside my head.

lines.zh: 水母都散了，我饿得发空。
lines.en: The jellyfish are gone; I am hollow with hunger.

lines.zh: 海面一亮，我整条都僵住。
lines.en: The surface flares; my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 水没了，连浮起来都做不到。
lines.en: No water left; I cannot even float.
